newsitem.title: USA: US late cash prods mixed amid slew of fundamentals.
newsitem.headline: US late cash prods mixed amid slew of fundamentals.

text.p: U.S. spot heating oil and New York Harbor gasoline took a beating with NYMEX late Wednesday, but blossoming differentials turned Gulf Coast gasoline into a winner as the market pondered lower domestic output and a Venezuela refinery problem.

Gulf Coast gasoline came alive mid afternoon, with differentials on M4-grade conventional unleaded and A4-grade reformulated swelling by an impressive 1.40 cents a gallon, with front-31st-cycle M4 sold for 2.0 cents over the print, players said.
"Three big majors were in buying on the front side and the sellers have now backed away," anticipating even stronger diffs Thursday, one Gulf trader said.

He attributed the newfound strength to a combination of factors, including Tuesday API data showing sharp cutbacks last week on gasoline production, to 7.25 million barrels a day from 7.62 million the prior week.
The data showed total U.S. gasoline stocks dropping about six million barrels.
